newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Chubais says Russia market regulation policy soon.
newsitem.headline: Chubais says Russia market regulation policy soon.

text.p: Russia will formulate a single policy in the next few weeks on securities markets regulation, the subject of a turf war between the central bank and other regulators, Finance Minister Anatoly Chubais said on Friday.

"I am sure that in the next few weeks we will solve the problem of a unified approach to the securities markets. A number of meetings, including one today, are planned on that issue," he told a news conference.

The Central Bank and Federal Commission on the Securities Market, which is in charge of securities markets and has ministerial status, disagree on a number of regulatory issues, including who should licence commercial banks to work on the markets.
The dispute has occasionally broken out into a bitter public row between senior officials from the two bodies.
"It is essential that this problem does not grow into an intragovernmental confrontation," Chubais said.

Chubais, who has also been First Deputy Prime Minister since a government reshuffle in which reformers were promoted, did not say whether he generally favoured the central bank or the Securities Commission.
